verificationIntro: Confirm your email address to finish setting up your Event Flow account.
verificationExpiry: This link expires in {hours, plural, one {one hour} other {# hours}}. Only the latest verification email can be used.
receivedIntro: Your application has been received and is pending review. We will email you when the organizer makes a decision.
organizerSubject: A new application for your event
organizerIntro: {name} has applied to attend your event. The application is pending review.
approvedIntro: Your application has been approved. We look forward to seeing you at the event.
cancelledAdmission: Your application was approved, but the event has since been cancelled. Your ticket history is preserved.
revokedAdmission: Your application was approved, but your admission has since been revoked. Your ticket history is preserved.
anonymousTicket: Your application has been approved and your ticket is ready. Keep this private ticket link safe; anyone with it can view your ticket.
accountTicket: Your application has been approved and your ticket is ready. Sign in to view it in your registration.
deletedAccount: Your application was approved. The account previously linked to this registration is no longer available.
rejectedIntro: Thank you for your interest. Your application was not approved.
cancelledIntro: The event you applied to has been cancelled. {reason}
anonymousApplication: Your application has been received and is awaiting review. Keep this private link safe: anyone holding it can view this application and withdraw it, including the whole party after approval.
resetIntro: We received a request to reset your Event Flow password. If you did not request this, ignore this email; your password will stay unchanged.
resetExpiry: This single-use link expires in {minutes} minutes. After resetting, sign in again with your new password.
